detail: No current scope violation: the reviewed planning commits change only the supporting spec. The final spec fixes the two non-blocking ownership/redaction ambiguities. This locks narrow implementation constraints, not implementation quality or functional acceptance.

findings.finding: Supporting work has its own report/spec name but cannot create a canonical feature, change F003 completion, or close parent F004/F005.
findings.resolution: Final spec lines 66-67 require BL-RELEASE-READINESS-F003 implementation tags. Existing features.json F003 and parent spec lines 57-76 and 103-104 already own the inventory script, workflow and additive preflight tests.

findings.finding: A blanket reading of the original prohibition on secret hashes could contradict preservation of the existing approved files.* hashes, including .env metadata.
findings.resolution: Final spec lines 63-66 limit the prohibition to new metadata and freeze the old files.* allowlist without removal or expansion. No new data, hashes, raw outputs or environment values may enter compose_probe.

findings.finding: The baseline query() normalizes capture failure to 1. Its result cannot supply the required original pipeline_exit_status. With pipefail, the recorded pipeline status also need not be Docker's own status.
findings.required_constraint: Keep query() byte-frozen. Instrument only the existing Compose capture with identical timeout --signal=KILL 5s / docker compose version --short / head -c 16385 argv; preserve the whole pipeline status before any status-masking operation. An exceeded retained capture cap takes precedence over a nonzero pipeline; never reinterpret 124, 137 or 141 as an internal cause.

findings.finding: captured_bytes describes the bounded shell string after command substitution strips trailing newlines, not emitted stdout/stderr. Shell string length must not silently become a multibyte character count under a non-C local test locale.
findings.required_constraint: Measure bytes of the retained string without adding host queries, changing global locale/shared query behavior, or widening bounds. Retain 16385-byte capture, 16384-byte rejection threshold, 5s query timeout, 150s SSH timeout and 65536-byte transport-report limit. Do not infer a total emitted byte count or repair newline/locale behavior elsewhere.

findings.finding: home_present is variable presence, not truthiness, a readable path, or proof of Docker plugin/config discovery. A present empty HOME must still be true.
findings.required_constraint: Use shell presence-only inspection, never serialize HOME, never inspect the path/config/plugin directories, and never restore or inherit HOME in the frozen SSH invocation.

findings.finding: The actual workflow filter is the transport allowlist. A surrogate validator or old-test adaptations would not prove the allowed change.
findings.required_constraint: Extend only the existing jq validator. Require exact compose_probe keys, enum, boolean, integer ranges and null/not_run relationships; reject extra secret-bearing keys. Execute every old host-preflight test byte-unchanged, add separate controls, pin every workflow byte outside the validator and shared/non-Compose script behavior, retain initial failures without retries to green.

findings.finding: The retained live report proves compose_unavailable before config/app/postgres identity collection. The frozen SSH invocation omits HOME. Neither proves that HOME or plugin discovery caused the refusal.
findings.required_constraint: No additional host query, plugin fallback, environment repair, installation, service/config/DB mutation, SSH/GH/Secrets operation or credential access by workers. Only Coordinator may publish the exact reviewed/evaluated non-main source and request protected human-reviewed host-preflight.

classification_contract.condition: retained string exceeds the unchanged cap, regardless of pipeline status
zero pipeline without exceeded cap and invalid existing semver
zero pipeline without exceeded cap and valid existing semver
